commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text: Someone who envies what is given to others brings ruin on their kin, who perish without food or clothing. If the kin are ruined, that person’s own ruin needs no saying. Envy of another’s gain loses you your own gain and your kin’s as well.
